summary: Captures camera images from a Leap Motion/Ultraleap controller, with controls for API generation, library location, camera selection, image flipping, correction, and HMD mode.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Capture data from the cameras while enabled

key_params.name: api
key_params.note: default for Version 2 Tracking, on for Orion/Gemini V4/V5

key_params.name: libfolder
key_params.note: Folder containing Leap.dll or LeapC.dll for the selected SDK

key_params.name: hmd
key_params.note: default, on, or off head-mounted display mode

common_gotchas: Allow Images must be enabled outside TouchDesigner or the TOP will not receive camera images.
The library folder must match the selected SDK version; V2 uses Leap.dll and V4/V5 use LeapC.dll.
Gemini V5 tracking has different orientation behavior than legacy V2/V4 setups.
TouchDesigner does not include an Ultraleap hardware or software license.
api=on means Orion/Gemini tracking, not a generic active toggle.
key_concepts: Captures Leap Motion or Ultraleap camera images for tracking-camera workflows.
Requires Allow Images in the external Leap/Ultraleap Control Panel before images are available.
The api menu selects legacy V2 tracking or Orion/Gemini V4/V5 tracking behavior.
libfolder must point at the matching Leap.dll or LeapC.dll library location for the selected SDK.
flip and correction controls orient the camera image for the selected mounting setup.
TouchDesigner does not include Leap hardware or software licensing.
